hypothesis: Monthly relative momentum across equity, gold and long-duration Treasuries, combined with an absolute positive-return filter, captures persistent cross-asset trends while moving to cash in broad downtrends.
academic_basis: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen, Time Series Momentum, Journal of Financial Economics 2012

rule.rebalance: monthly; rank using month-end closes through month t-1 and hold selected asset during month t
rule.selection: single asset with highest trailing 12-month total return if positive, otherwise cash
